Agent: Hi Sarah, thanks for coming down to view the unit today. Before we walk in, I just wanted to confirm — you're still looking at Marine Parade Central as the priority area, yes?

Sarah: Yes, definitely. My parents are in Marine Parade and we really want to be within walking distance. Husband agrees on the location, finally.

Agent: That's great. And on the budget side, you mentioned 1.8 million as the firm ceiling — has anything changed there?

Sarah: No, that's still our hard cap. We've spoken to the bank and that's what we're approved for. Anything above that, even by 50k, we just can't stretch.

Agent: Understood. So today we're looking at three units, all between 1.65 and 1.78. The one we're walking into now is the corner unit on the fourteenth floor — best layout in the stack but the highest price.

Sarah: OK. One thing I should mention — my husband is starting to worry about the timing. He thinks rates might still come down a bit more this year. He wants me to push for a slower decision.

Agent: That's fair. We don't need to rush. If we find the right unit today, I can structure the OTP timeline to give you both more buffer.

Sarah: I appreciate that. Also — could you send me the actual floor plan after this? I want to take it home and look at it properly with my husband on the weekend.

Agent: Absolutely. I'll WhatsApp you the floor plan PDF this evening, along with the comparables for the surrounding units sold in the last six months. Anything else you need?

Sarah: Just one more thing — what's the lease balance? We don't want to go below 80 years left.

Agent: This block has 92 years remaining. We're well above your threshold. I'll include that in the package I send tonight.
